title: Bill Gates, “The next outbreak? We're not ready” (what went wrong with Ebola)

meta.charla: The next outbreak? We're not ready
meta.tema: Sistemas: lo que falló con el ébola

lines: And as you look at what went on,
the problem wasn't that there was a system / that didn't work well enough,
the problem was that we didn't have a system at all.
In fact, there are some pretty obvious key missing pieces.
We didn't have a group of epidemiologists ready to go,
who would have gone, / seen what the disease was, / seen how far it had spread.
The case reports came in on paper.
It was very delayed before they were put online,
We didn't have a medical team ready to go.
We didn't have a way of preparing people.
Now, Médecins Sans Frontières / did a great job orchestrating volunteers.
But even so, / we were far slower than we should have been
getting the thousands of workers into these countries.
And a large epidemic would require us / to have hundreds of thousands of workers.
There was no one there to look at treatment approaches.
No one to look at the diagnostics.
listen_for: Problem-solution structure you can reuse at work: the problem wasn't…, the problem was… · repetition for emphasis: We didn't have… We didn't have…, No one to… · should have been → “should've been”.
notas: Subtítulos TED + Whisper small.en. El audio dice «there are some pretty obvious»; se sigue el audio. Whisper no reconoce «Médecins Sans Frontières» y añade «years»: falsos positivos.
